geopolitics_summary: Houthis tighten Red Sea chokepoint control; US EPA scraps power-plant climate rules; EU emphasizes strategic independence amid trade tensions.

themes.headline: Houthis seize Red Sea islands, threaten global oil & LNG transit
themes.why_it_matters: Red Sea disruption raises LNG shipping costs and delays to NW Europe; tightens global LNG supply, pushes TTF upward via scarcity premium and forces EU to compete harder for alternative Atlantic supply.

themes.headline: Corpus Christi LNG Stage 3 completed; US now second-largest exporter
themes.why_it_matters: Additional US LNG export capacity (7th train online) increases Atlantic supply competing with EU sourcing; soft TTF via lower marginal cost of US LNG reaching Europe; reduces geopolitical scarcity premium on European gas.

themes.headline: EPA scraps US power-plant climate curbs; weakens global decarbonization momentum
themes.why_it_matters: US climate policy reversal may slow global emissions reductions, indirectly lowering EUA price via reduced scarcity narrative and potential oversupply of allowances if EU counterparties assume weaker global carbon regime.

themes.headline: Von der Leyen emphasizes EU independence; China trade deficit at tipping point
themes.why_it_matters: EU rebalancing trade policy may increase green-tech tariffs on Chinese renewables & battery components, raising capex costs for EU power-sector decarbonization and indirectly supporting higher carbon prices if transition investment stalls.

themes.headline: US crude oil production hits record 13.8 Mb/d in 2026; maintains global supply glut
themes.why_it_matters: High US crude output dampens oil price; lowers energy-sector investment returns and reduces fuel-switching incentive from coal/gas to oil for power generation in Europe; soft indirect pressure on gas demand and power spreads.

watchlist: Von der Leyen State of the Union policy announcements on climate/energy investment (16 Sept expected detail).
Red Sea Bab el-Mandeb shipping corridor — monitor Houthi escalation and LNG diversion costs weekly.
Corpus Christi Stage 3 ramp-up: track first cargoes and utilisation rates; TTF arb impact over 4 weeks.
EU–China trade negotiation timeline; green-tech tariff decisions by Oct–Nov; carbon/renewables capex implications.
